g1.flow: A double warning to the man who went to his people swaggering (75:33). The first is bare: awlā laka fa-awlā. The second repeats it with thumma in front: thumma awlā laka fa-awlā. Then the surah turns to a question: 'Does man think he will be left neglected?' Hook: plain first, thumma second, like fa-qutila then thumma qutila in Al-Muddaththir.

cues.75:34: First, no thumma: right after he went to his people swaggering.
cues.75:35: Second, starts with thumma; next asks if man thinks he'll be left neglected.
